name: Kingdomino Origin

categories.label: Region points (squares x fires)
categories.hint: Per region: number of squares times Fire symbols (printed + Fire tokens) inside it; a region without fire scores 0. Enter the sum over regions.

categories.label: Wooden resources left (Totem Mode)
categories.hint: 1 point per wooden resource still on your dominoes (Totem Mode only).

categories.label: Totem tiles bonus (Totem Mode)
categories.hint: Sum of bonus points printed on the Totem tiles you hold.

categories.label: Hunter-gatherer points (Tribe Mode)
categories.hint: One entry per hunter-gatherer: points from its own condition (resources/fires around it).

categories.label: Warrior group points (Tribe Mode)
categories.hint: One entry per orthogonally connected warrior group: warriors x total power; a lone warrior = its power.

categories.label: Empire of fire (optional)
categories.hint: +10 if your hut is in the centre of your territory.

categories.label: Homo Habilis (optional)
categories.hint: +5 if your 5x5 territory is complete and no domino was discarded.

categories.label: Biggest region (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Size of your largest region, with or without fire.

categories.label: Fire symbols (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Total Fire symbols in your territory.

tiebreakers.description: Biggest region, whether or not it contains fire

notes: family: set-collection. Three modes: Discovery (regionPoints only), Totem (+resourcesLeft +totemBonus), Tribe (+cavemen; resources placed at setup score nothing and Totem tiles are not used). Empire of fire and Homo Habilis are optional rules for any mode. 2-player Neolithic option uses 7x7 territories (not modelled). Totem tile values and hunter-gatherer conditions are printed on components and not given in the rulebook text, so they are scorer inputs.

sources.title: Kingdomino Origins rulebook (Blue Orange)
sources.section: pp.3-6 End of the Game (each mode), Cavemen, optional rules
